module_summary: RISC-V machine-mode CSR file: CSR registers updated by a priority chain (interrupt, eret, exception, CSR write), with masked interrupt logic, cycle counter, read mux and trap branch generation.

anchors.name: exception_i
anchors.why: Exception/interrupt/eret/fence code selecting which CSR update and branch happen.

anchors.name: is_exception_w
anchors.why: Decoded exception class steering trap state save and mtvec branch.

anchors.name: csr_sr_q
anchors.why: mstatus register: interrupt enable, previous enable/privilege; masks interrupts, drives status_o.

anchors.name: csr_mepc_q
anchors.why: Saved trap PC; target for MRET branch.

anchors.name: csr_mcause_q
anchors.why: Trap cause register written on interrupt or exception.

anchors.name: csr_mtval_q
anchors.why: Trap value register holding faulting address or PC.

anchors.name: csr_mtvec_q
anchors.why: Trap vector base; branch target on interrupt or machine exception.

anchors.name: csr_mip_q
anchors.why: Interrupt pending register set by external, timer and compare interrupts.

anchors.name: csr_mie_q
anchors.why: Interrupt enable mask ANDed with pending to form interrupts.

anchors.name: csr_mscratch_q
anchors.why: Software scratch CSR, read and written via CSR port.

anchors.name: csr_mpriv_q
anchors.why: Current privilege level, changed on traps and returns, drives priv_o.

anchors.name: csr_mcycle_q
anchors.why: Free-running cycle counter; compared with mtimecmp, readable as mcycle/mtime.

anchors.name: csr_mcycle_h_q
anchors.why: Upper cycle counter incremented on lower counter overflow.

anchors.name: csr_mtimecmp_q
anchors.why: Timer compare value raising timer interrupt when mcycle matches.

anchors.name: csr_mtime_ie_q
anchors.why: Arms timer compare interrupt; set on mtimecmp write, cleared on match.

anchors.name: csr_mideleg_q
anchors.why: Interrupt delegation to supervisor; disabled when SUPPORT_SUPER is 0.

anchors.name: csr_stvec_q
anchors.why: Supervisor trap vector, representative supervisor CSR, disabled by parameter.

anchors.name: irq_masked_r
anchors.why: Pending and enabled interrupts gated by mstatus MIE; drives interrupt_o.

anchors.name: irq_priv_q
anchors.why: Latched target privilege of pending interrupt; selects machine or supervisor trap handling.

anchors.name: csr_mip_upd_q
anchors.why: Flags in-progress MIP read so new pending bits are buffered.

anchors.name: csr_mip_next_q
anchors.why: Buffered interrupt pending bits merged into mip.

anchors.name: interrupt_o
anchors.why: Masked interrupt vector to pipeline; also selects interrupt cause.

anchors.name: csr_raddr_i
anchors.why: CSR read address selecting register in read mux.

anchors.name: csr_rdata_o
anchors.why: CSR read data from masked read mux.

anchors.name: rdata_r
anchors.why: CSR read mux result.

anchors.name: csr_waddr_i
anchors.why: CSR write address selecting which CSR takes write data.

anchors.name: csr_wdata_i
anchors.why: CSR write data masked into the addressed CSR.

anchors.name: exception_pc_i
anchors.why: PC of trapping instruction saved into mepc, also fence return target.

anchors.name: csr_branch_o
anchors.why: Pipeline redirect request on trap, return or fence.

anchors.name: csr_target_o
anchors.why: Redirect target: mtvec, mepc, stvec, sepc or pc+4.

groups.name: trap_controller
groups.description: Prioritizes interrupt, eret, exception and CSR write updates; manages privilege.

groups.name: machine_csrs
groups.description: Machine CSRs mstatus, mepc, mcause, mtval, mtvec, mscratch with next-state logic.

groups.name: supervisor_csrs
groups.description: Supervisor CSRs and delegation, disabled when SUPPORT_SUPER is 0.

groups.name: interrupt_logic
groups.description: Pending/enable registers, masking and buffered external/timer interrupt capture.

groups.name: cycle_timer
groups.description: 64-bit cycle counter with mtimecmp compare timer interrupt.

groups.name: csr_access_port
groups.description: CSR read mux and write address/data port.

groups.name: branch_gen
groups.description: Generates pipeline redirect and target for traps, returns and fences.
